loginImage.label: Login Page Image
loginImage.description: Upload a family photo to replace the default illustration on your login page. Visitors will see it when they open your family link.

loginDesigner.title: Login Page Designer
loginDesigner.description: Make your family's login page your own — pick a theme, or go full retro with your own HTML & CSS.
loginDesigner.teaser: Customize your whole login page: choose a theme with colors and decorations, or design it yourself with HTML & CSS.
loginDesigner.modeClassicDesc: The standard page with your family photo.
loginDesigner.modeThemeDesc: Pick colors, fonts and decorations — no code needed.
loginDesigner.modeCustomDesc: Design the whole page with your own HTML & CSS.
loginDesigner.welcomeMessagePlaceholder: e.g. Enter the family password to see our memories
loginDesigner.loginBoxMinimizedDesc: Your page is fully visible; a small "Sign in" button opens the login.
loginDesigner.loginBoxCardDesc: The login card floats on top of your page.
loginDesigner.securityNote: Scripts, forms, and embeds are automatically removed for safety. The login box always stays on top of your page.
loginDesigner.loadTemplateConfirm: Replace your current HTML & CSS with the starter template?
loginDesigner.imagesHint: Upload images here, then copy their URLs into your HTML.
loginDesigner.resetConfirm: Reset your login page to the classic look? Your theme and code stay saved, but visitors will see the classic page.
loginDesigner.tooLong: Your code is too long — please shorten it before saving.

shareLink.label: Family Share Link
shareLink.description: Share this link with family and friends so they can access your memories.

password.label: Change Shared Password (Private Key)
password.description: This is the password family and friends use to access the site.
password.tooShort: Password must be at least 4 characters

familyName.label: Family Name
familyName.invalidUrl: Family name produces an invalid URL — please use letters or numbers
familyName.taken: This family name is already taken — please choose another

cardStyle.label: Memory Card Style
cardStyle.description: Choose how memories look in your family home feed. Everyone in the family sees the same style.
cardStyle.polaroidTip: Tip: customize each memory's border color, width, style, and decoration when posting or editing it.
cardStyle.updateFailed: Failed to update memory card style

export.label: Data Export / NAS Backup
export.description: Download all your family's data and media as a ZIP file. Save it to your NAS, external drive, or cloud storage for safekeeping.
export.complete: Export complete! Check your downloads folder.

optimizePhotos.label: Optimise photos
optimizePhotos.description: Photos uploaded before this feature existed are still loaded at full resolution everywhere. This creates a small preview copy of each one. Originals are never changed.
optimizePhotos.allDone: All {{count}} posts with photos are optimised.
optimizePhotos.resumeHint: You can stop any time and pick up where you left off — nothing is lost.
optimizePhotos.error: Something went wrong. You can safely try again.

admins.label: Manage Admins
admins.description: Generate a one-time invite link to add another admin. They'll set their own password. Each admin is bound to this family only.
admins.removeConfirm: Remove {{email}} from this family? They will no longer be able to sign in here.
admins.inviteLinkDescription: Share this link with the new admin. It is valid for 7 days and can only be used once.
admins.revokeConfirm: Revoke this invite link? It can no longer be used.
